bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 81d75017d0fd0ddc631e0c6de862c1cc0d4d662d
want=$(sha256sum "$w/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
got=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d ' ' -f1)
test "$want" = "$got"
data=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c '
import json,os,urllib.request
head={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}
def read(path):
 req=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+path,headers=head)
 return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8))
m=read("/internal/metrics/status")
r=read("/internal/resources/status")
assert m["window_capacity"]==256
assert set(m["model_metrics"])=={"granite","qwen3","ministral","coder"}
print("METRICS="+m["persistence"]+" SAMPLES="+str(m["window_completed"])+" ACTIVE="+str(sum(r["active"].values()))+" QUEUE="+str(r["queued"]))
')
if ss -H -ltn 'sport = :18080' | grep -q LISTEN; then exit 81; fi
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_DURABLE_METRICS_HOST_READY HEAD=81d75017d0fd0ddc631e0c6de862c1cc0d4d662d SOURCE_MATCH=YES $data PORT18080=CLOSED" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_DURABLE_METRICS_HOST_READY=PASS
